title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Dana Montalto is a Lecturer-on-Law, Senior Clinical Instructor, and Associate Director of the Veterans Legal Clinic at the Legal Services Center of Harvard Law School. She represents veterans and their families in a range of state and federal veterans benefits appeals and in military discharge upgrade petitions. Dana also founded the Veterans Justice Pro Bono […]
